Yvette leads her team to Belan Fort for its first paranormal investigation. Strange activity starts immediately, and one member is scared out of their wits.
With so much to investigate the team continue inside the Fort and the spirits that are said to reside there keeps giving them the run-a-round.
The epic investigation into the hauntings of Belan Fort with entering the dock area and outer buildings. Where one of the team realises they are being followed.

The team enter an old church in Leeds. The Priest’s Cottage not only boasts a great deal of paranormal activity itself, it also has haunted objects to add to the strange occurrences that have been witnessed with stark regularity.
The team continue their investigation into this remarkable place and the spirits that are said to haunt keep team on their toes.

Yvette takes the Most Haunted team to Wales to conduct a full investigation in the daylight, as most of the haunting occur before the darkness of night. An investigation that proved unrestful spirits do not just inhabit the night.
We continue our daylight investigation into Plas Coch and the team look deeper into the strange happenings of this historic house.
The team enter a museum full of vehicular artefacts, a haunted building with haunted attractions and the many spirits said to roam a quick to make their presence known.
The Most Haunted team split into smaller groups and continue their investigation into the past of public transport.
With night drawing in, the team carry on into the vast darkness of Manchester’s Transport Museum.
